questions.q: Find the equation of the tangent to the curve y = 3x² - 4x + 1 at the point (2, 5).
A particle moves in a straight line such that its displacement s meters after t seconds is given by s = t³ - 6t² + 9t. Find the acceleration when the velocity is zero.
questions.exp: v = ds/dt = 3t² - 12t + 9. Setting v = 0 gives t = 1 or t = 3. Acceleration a = dv/dt = 6t - 12. At t=1, a = -6; at t=3, a = 6.
log₂[x(x-2)] = 3 ⇒ x² - 2x = 2³ = 8 ⇒ x² - 2x - 8 = 0 ⇒ (x-4)(x+2) = 0. Since log argument must be positive, x = 4.

questions.q: If 9^(x+1) - 28(3^x) + 3 = 0, find the values of x.
What mass of CaCO₃ is required to produce 4.4 g of CO₂ upon complete thermal decomposition? (Ca=40, C=12, O=16)
questions.exp: CaCO₃ → CaO + CO₂. Molar mass CaCO₃ = 100 g/mol, CO₂ = 44 g/mol. Moles CO₂ = 4.4/44 = 0.1 mol. Mass CaCO₃ = 0.1 × 100 = 10.0 g.

questions.q: Calculate the molarity of a solution formed by dissolving 5.85 g of NaCl in distilled water to make 250 cm³ of solution. (Na=23, Cl=35.5)
questions.exp: Molar mass NaCl = 58.5 g/mol. Moles = 5.85 / 58.5 = 0.1 mol. Volume = 0.25 L. Molarity = 0.1 / 0.25 = 0.4 M.

questions.q: A 12V battery with internal resistance 1Ω is connected across two parallel resistors of 6Ω and 3Ω. Calculate the current supplied by the battery.
questions.exp: Parallel resistance R_p = (6 × 3) / (6 + 3) = 2Ω. Total circuit resistance = R_p + r = 2 + 1 = 3Ω. Total current I = V / R_total = 12 / 3 = 4.0 A.
